# Reclaim Deco

> Reclaim Deco (formerly Reclaimed NYC) sells new, open-box and pre-owned designer furniture below retail, with local delivery across the New York metro area and nationwide shipping by quote. Warehouse at 101 Church St, Matawan, NJ 07747, open by appointment only.

- Founded July 2026 by Eric Reid and Charlie Hodges. Started selling a family member's couch, grew into a 1,000 sq ft warehouse in Jersey City, now a 5,000 sq ft warehouse in Matawan, NJ.
- Brands carried: RH (Restoration Hardware), Herman Miller, Ekornes / Stressless, West Elm, Castlery (incl. Tan France x Castlery), Stickley, Ralph Lauren Home, Bernhardt, Ethan Allen, Knoll, Kartell, Geiger, Keilhauer, Coalesse, HAY, Universum.
- Categories: sofas and sectionals, lounge and accent chairs, dining tables and chairs, bar stools, coffee and side tables, storage and media, bedroom, rugs, mirrors, outdoor, office.
- Restored tag: pieces marked Restored have had their leather professionally restored by Caleb Repp of Repp Leather Services, who also takes on restoration projects directly.
- Sell or consign: Reclaim Deco accepts like-new or excellent-condition furniture from the brands it carries (or comparable quality), with a cash offer or consignment on its platform. Start by messaging photos, brand/model and location.
- How to order: message Reclaim Deco on Facebook Messenger (https://m.me/reclaimed.nyc) or email eric@reclaimed.nyc.
- Delivery: local delivery across New Jersey, New York City and the surrounding region, priced on a sliding scale by mileage (quote on request). Nationwide shipping through uShip, by quote. Buyers deal directly with the owners.
